description: Subtitle alignment and correction utilities for processing subtitle entries in conjunction with Whisper transcript segments. Functions include normalizing text, ensuring monotonic timestamps, matching subtitles to transcript segments based on overlap and proximity, merging blank subtitles, and aligning/substituting text and timestamps for more accurate subtitle timing.

methods.name: bool _is_blank(text: Optional[str])
methods.description: Checks if a string is None or contains only whitespace.

methods.name: str _normalize_space(text: str)
methods.description: Collapses multiple whitespace characters into one and trims the string.

methods.name: float _overlap(a: Tuple[float, float], b: Tuple[float, float])
methods.description: Calculates the duration of overlap between two time intervals.

methods.name: float _interval_center(iv: Tuple[float, float])
methods.description: Calculates the midpoint of a time interval.

methods.name: float _safe_time(t: float)
methods.description: Ensures timestamps are non-negative by clamping negatives to zero.

methods.name: Any _get_seg_value(seg: Any, key: str, default: Any = None)
methods.description: Safely retrieves a value from a segment, which may be a dict or object.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _to_seg_dict(seg: Any)
methods.description: Converts various segment representations into a standard dict with start, end, and text.

methods.name: None _ensure_monotonic(subs: List[Dict], min_gap: float = 0.02)
methods.description: Adjusts subtitle list in-place to enforce non-overlapping, increasing start times with minimal gaps.

methods.name: Optional[int] _match_transcript_segment( sub_iv: Tuple[float, float], transcript: List[Dict], )
methods.description: Finds the index of the transcript segment most overlapping or closest in time to a subtitle interval.

methods.name: Optional[int] _closest_transcript_index_by_time(point: float, transcript: List[Dict])
methods.description: Finds transcript segment index whose center is closest to a given point.

methods.name: List[Dict] _merge_adjacent_blanks(subs: List[Dict])
methods.description: Merges consecutive blank ('') text subtitles to reduce fragmentation.

methods.name: None _apply_text_from_transcript(sub: Dict, seg: Dict)
methods.description: Replaces subtitle text with transcript segment text if subtitle text is missing or blank.

methods.name: None _refit_times_to_segment(sub: Dict, seg: Dict)
methods.description: Refines subtitle start/end times to better match a transcript segment while respecting duration constraints.

methods.name: List[Dict] align_subtitles(transcript: List[Dict], subtitles: List[Dict])
methods.description: Main function to align and correct subtitles based on a Whisper transcript. It normalizes inputs, matches subtitles to transcript segments, adjusts timestamps and text, merges blanks, enforces monotonicity, and outputs the corrected subtitles list.

ctags.name: _get_seg_value
ctags.pattern: /^def _get_seg_value(seg: Any, key: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:$/
ctags.signature: (seg: Any, key: str, default: Any = None)

ctags.name: _overlap
ctags.pattern: /^def _overlap(a: Tuple[float, float], b: Tuple[float, float]) -> float:$/
